The **Project Management Professional (PMP)** certification is a globally recognized credential offered by the [Project Management Institute (PMI)](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXn4w9FRgG8MtqQ5ni02RFRP2wNv0lVNC6vK2BU4-EKsg79J3napq5wTPGtzAyhd9HO9zp4dKWnEfWC9DQUn8Ddc9cNG3nk_mfFW6QIRy7WtX0db1DYxeATTNP9PiCtx3z79RvIUdSBndh02vhlfm0NwE) that validates your skill in leading and managing projects across predictive, agile, and hybrid approaches.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXn4w9FRgG8MtqQ5ni02RFRP2wNv0lVNC6vK2BU4-EKsg79J3napq5wTPGtzAyhd9HO9zp4dKWnEfWC9DQUn8Ddc9cNG3nk_mfFW6QIRy7WtX0db1DYxeATTNP9PiCtx3z79RvIUdSBndh02vhlfm0NwE)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEStQEBxCJF1yM239IFZTcoFLni8tul6XNpmDnS4oSCwYIbJnlz_zAcdKwmnOJv8BG1SH1LMP2uQ0SY6mJ_Y8-2BcAVNCZKkIjW-Pyo-tSkbar8Aux-8lRh_BK876jkFLfJPJrqqq2zhQcnxTXjxUbnsuKTPb2rPHoxNfQLKCm2bTET3fg85qqFxHh6uh_cCS_NLaki6qXt5xIsS22Zb8qJlaX-MCsj2CfEOeZTuhLdp7ACglKOwbuA)

### Eligibility Requirements

- **Four-Year Degree Path:** 36 months of project-leading experience within the past 8 years.
- **High School Diploma / Associate's Degree Path:** 60 months of project-leading experience within the past 8 years.
- **Education Requirement:** 35 hours of project management education, training, or an active CAPM certification.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXn4w9FRgG8MtqQ5ni02RFRP2wNv0lVNC6vK2BU4-EKsg79J3napq5wTPGtzAyhd9HO9zp4dKWnEfWC9DQUn8Ddc9cNG3nk_mfFW6QIRy7WtX0db1DYxeATTNP9PiCtx3z79RvIUdSBndh02vhlfm0NwE)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEStQEBxCJF1yM239IFZTcoFLni8tul6XNpmDnS4oSCwYIbJnlz_zAcdKwmnOJv8BG1SH1LMP2uQ0SY6mJ_Y8-2BcAVNCZKkIjW-Pyo-tSkbar8Aux-8lRh_BK876jkFLfJPJrqqq2zhQcnxTXjxUbnsuKTPb2rPHoxNfQLKCm2bTET3fg85qqFxHh6uh_cCS_NLaki6qXt5xIsS22Zb8qJlaX-MCsj2CfEOeZTuhLdp7ACglKOwbuA)

### Exam Details

- **Format:** 180 questions (mixture of multiple-choice, matching, multiple-response, and fill-in-the-blank).
- **Time Limit:** 240 minutes (4 hours) with two 10-minute breaks.
- **Domains:** People (33%), Process (41%), and Business Environment (26%).
- **Delivery:** In-person at Pearson VUE test centers or via online proctoring.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXn4w9FRgG8MtqQ5ni02RFRP2wNv0lVNC6vK2BU4-EKsg79J3napq5wTPGtzAyhd9HO9zp4dKWnEfWC9DQUn8Ddc9cNG3nk_mfFW6QIRy7WtX0db1DYxeATTNP9PiCtx3z79RvIUdSBndh02vhlfm0NwE)

### Cost

- **PMI Members:** $405 (plus membership and application fees)
- **Non-Members:** $655 (plus application fees)[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXn4w9FRgG8MtqQ5ni02RFRP2wNv0lVNC6vK2BU4-EKsg79J3napq5wTPGtzAyhd9HO9zp4dKWnEfWC9DQUn8Ddc9cNG3nk_mfFW6QIRy7WtX0db1DYxeATTNP9PiCtx3z79RvIUdSBndh02vhlfm0NwE)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmAEBxCJF1zWZ1QHSg5nj5HjergJv1KvjF7u1Q7smJzh3kXwSbxGEhHaTHAojCiN2Do-_octqkMH-l_iZel-GZQ-mcWdqnLdNI0QSluu4S1gUKiWsCLlr01g3mGJH73MUyrj0cgAjdnSXEBLjQu1dtY7WwyJbUHVSu2Oal43r0eb1rvc58W6XlP9oXvIQ6GD-QJfvtkrJ1cHdQQ)

### Maintenance

- The certification is active for a 3-year cycle, during which you must earn **60 Professional Development Units (PDUs)** to renew.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s_zUJ1QOn58)
